output.brief: The most likely cause is the alert relay server move on 12 August. The change record shows 11 of the 14 forwarding rules were silently skipped during import. Those rules included a 15-second hold-off that filtered brief SpO2 alarms and a rule that suppressed repeat notifications. Phone notifications per nurse roughly doubled from 12 August in Pods A-C only. Delayed responses rose there across core, agency and new nurses. Pod D still uses the old server and stayed flat, even with a similar agency share. Bedside alarm volume did not change, and the September software update shows no step. Staffing and acuity do not explain the pattern. Confidence is moderate to good. The mechanism is documented but not yet tested live. Next steps: restore the lost rules with Clinical Engineering validation and Alarm Committee sign-off, then track notifications and acknowledgement times weekly. Do not approve the agency cap or the nurse reviews. Do not stop phone alarms.
